title: Map Washer
description: Did you waste a map by mistake? Make it blank again now!
body:
# Map Washer

Map Washer is a lightweight utility mod that introduces a vanilla-friendly mechanic to recycle mapped item data.

## Mechanics

* **Map Resetting:** Right-clicking a filled map on a water cauldron reverts the item back into a blank map.
* **Resource Depletion:** Each washing cycle lowers the cauldron's water level by one layer, matching standard vanilla behavior.

## Technical Specifications

* **Loader:** Fabric Loader
* **Dependency:** Fabric API
* **Runtime:** Java 25 or higher
